issue.title: Answer unresolved hijack recoveries from Telegram and mobile
issue.description:
Proposed by land phase sase-1qz.11 (note #1) of epic sase-1qz (Agent Hijack, plan:202611/agent_hijack.md), which listed remote answering as a deferred follow-up.

Today a HIJACKED agent can only be recovered from the ACE recovery panel (Enter on the row) or `sase agent recover NAME`. A user away from the terminal cannot see that an agent is held or choose what happens to its work.

Shape: surface unresolved hijacks (state held/expired) to an authorized Telegram or mobile user with the same preview facts the panel shows (`hijack_recovery_preview`: model, run duration, diff totals, escalation target), and let them pick Escalate, Continue, Restart, or Dismiss. Submit through `sase ops agent persist-recover` with the previewed `expected_hijack_id` and `expected_revision` so a stale choice fails closed exactly like the TUI path.

task_type_fields.proposal: Let an authorized Telegram or mobile user see a HIJACKED agent's recovery preview and choose Escalate, Continue, Restart, or Dismiss, submitted CAS-pinned through sase ops agent persist-recover.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1qz delivered only the TUI panel and CLI; remote answering needs sase-telegram plugin work and an authorization design, which the plan explicitly deferred.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1qz's land phase (sase-1qz.11) deferred remote answering of hijacked agents; held work is otherwise invisible to a user away from the terminal.
